_comment: Committed PDK pin for the gf180-fpga flow. Read by flow/setup-pdk.sh.
The revision is the open_pdks commit klayout-tools' eda-sim image uses
klt_spec is the single klayout-tools pin: flow/klt.sh and the CI workflow read it.
klayout_spec pins klt's own KLayout engine to the version that klt pin was
tested against, so a fresh KLayout release cannot silently change a DRC/LVS
This file pins the toolchain only. Which variant, library and metal stack
the tile uses is a spec decision (#2), not made here: smoke_variant is the
variant the bring-up smoke ran against, and nothing more.
